title: coding-study runner conformance expectations
description: The outcome every runner must produce for each conformance fixture and approach. Spec: docs/specs/runners.md#conformance-suite

approach.description: Approach id declared in the fixture's meta.yaml

outcome.description: Expected for every case unless cases overrides it

cases.description: Per-case overrides, keyed by case id

status.description: pass: runner status ok and the problem's comparator accepts the output; load_error applies to the whole job; fail and stalled: stress cases only

op_index.description: error in a class kind: the failing operation

partial_output.description: error in a class kind: outputs before the failing operation

stdout.description: pass: the exact captured standard output

min_failed.description: Stress cases: at least this many runs fail with status (default: every run)

max_failed.description: Stress cases: at most this many runs fail (default 0 with pass)

deterministic.description: Stress cases: a repeated seed gives an identical run record, and different seeds give at least two distinct records

restart_requested.description: Stress cases: the runner asked to be restarted after a run of the case
